gen-gf-playpen-sans-fs-amulya: Loose, rope-like strokes: Playpen Sans looks hand-drawn, relaxed and a bit personal. Amulya steps in with low-contrast plain sans curves that stay generously open, pleasant in modest helpings beside it.
gen-gf-playpen-sans-fs-neco: Relaxed and hand-drawn, Playpen Sans keeps one unshaded line and a broad, welcoming c. And Neco, a serif with a measured swell from hairline to stem, carries the authority, though not for long paragraphs.
gen-gf-playpen-sans-fs-recia: Relaxed and hand-drawn, Playpen Sans draws one steady line. Recia, a text serif with openings that stay generous and modulation you spot only up close, brings sharp polish to the looseness, built for brief visits.
gen-gf-playpen-sans-fs-rowan: Playpen Sans has no stroke contrast at all, just a hand-drawn line. Rowan, a text serif whose thin strokes are about half its thick ones, feels related yet literary, and does better in a quick line or two.
gen-gf-playpen-sans-outfit: Hand-drawn and relaxed, Playpen Sans leads. Outfit, a plain sans with curves that stop well short of closing and no swelling or thinning, keeps things approachable and suited to quick glances.
gen-gf-playpen-sans-sora: Loose and hand-drawn, Playpen Sans brings a relaxed, personal touch with a broad, welcoming c and an unshaded outline. Sora tidies things up with precise, geometric curves, though not for long paragraphs.
gen-gf-playpen-sans-arabic-fs-amulya: Friendly, drafting-pen lines from Playpen Sans Arabic, hand-drawn with curve tips that never quite touch. Amulya adds a modern sans with low contrast and generous curve gaps, good for a couple of lines.
gen-gf-playpen-sans-arabic-fs-neco: Playpen Sans Arabic bends one thin, rod-like line into every letter. Neco, a text serif with a measured swell, brings dignity, so that hand-drawn lightness meets authority, better when text stays brief.
gen-gf-playpen-sans-arabic-fs-recia: A rolling-ball pen trail: Playpen Sans Arabic looks hand-drawn, single-width and friendly. Recia, a sharp serif whose strokes vary only slightly, supplies the best quality here: warmth held in check, good when used lightly.
gen-gf-playpen-sans-arabic-fs-rowan: Friendly and hand-drawn, Playpen Sans Arabic keeps a neon-tube constant stroke. Rowan, a literary serif with generous openings and faintly modulated strokes, is happier away from long paragraphs, so give it a slightly larger size.
